title: 会爬树的恐龙 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible hatching strokes and soft layered shading, moss green, warm brown and pale gold

pages.scene: One single small feathered dinosaur the size of a crow, seen from the side facing left, long feathers growing from both its arms and both its legs, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
